technical-summary: Closed RUM06. PR 1272 replaced the process-global remote-MoE registry, DSO constructor registration, TLS-selected owner and DSO-global hook state with one opaque engine-owned generation: explicit factory bind, serial handles with a lifetime borrow, owner-bound mailbox init, failure-atomic factory, derived startup/readiness/quiesce deadlines, and a clean-stop path that never interrupts a healthy ledger against a fault path that poisons and wakes peers. Three independent reviews drove fixes; host lifecycle suites pass under ASan/UBSan; card runs on the lane build (clean stop on flashnext-4gpu and qwen27b-tp3, helper kill takes the fault path and restarts cleanly, second engine refused, greedy output identical to the installed 2020.0.1) are recorded. Bound-ahead stop on hardware and an installed candidate are not yet proven.
user-summary-candidate: Remote MoE helper state is now owned by each engine generation instead of the process, so stopping and restarting engines, or a helper failure, no longer leaves shared global state behind.
